full_prompt_en: The image is a square impasto oil painting of a grinning abstract face built from thick multicolored paint. The face fills nearly the entire frame, pressing against the edges with only a few exposed white areas at the upper right and far side. On the upper left, a large black round eye is ringed by a raised yellow band, with a small orange center and blue strokes sweeping above it. On the right, a smaller dark circular mark sits inside rough red and white patches. Between them, an orange diagonal ridge suggests a nose. Across the middle and lower half, long red, orange, and blue strips stack into a wide curved grin. Jagged black and brown gaps under the bright red upper band suggest uneven teeth and a deep mouth. Hot pink and green blocks crowd the left edge, while cobalt, turquoise, white, and burgundy patches pull against them on the right. The paint is extremely thick: individual strokes stand up as ridges, their ends torn and their colors scraped across one another. Some areas reveal a rough underlying canvas, while other layers cast small physical shadows from raised pigment. There is no spatial background or distant setting; the whole picture is a close field of tactile color. Light from above picks out shiny high points on yellow, orange, and blue ridges and darkens the crevices. Despite its disorderly marks, the two eyes and sweeping grin create a clear expressive structure. The composition is playful and intense, with broad gestures, saturated complementary colors, and the material height of the paint carrying as much energy as the face itself.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形厚涂油画：一张咧嘴的抽象面孔由厚厚的多色颜料堆成。面孔几乎填满全幅，挤到画边，只有右上和侧边露出少量白底。左上方一只大黑圆眼被凸起黄带围住，中央有一点橙色，蓝色笔痕从上方扫过。右侧一块较小的暗圆落在粗糙红白色片里。两者之间，一道橙色斜脊暗示鼻子。中部与下半部，长红、橙、蓝色条层层搭出宽阔弯笑。亮红上沿下的参差黑棕缝暗示不齐的牙和深嘴。热粉与绿块挤在左边，右边的钴蓝、青绿、白与酒红片与之拉扯。颜料极厚：每道笔触都作为棱脊凸起，末端撕裂，颜色彼此刮过。某些地方露出粗糙底布，另一些颜料堆层的突起投下细小实物阴影。没有空间背景或远景；整幅画是贴近的可触色彩场。上方光勾出黄、橙与蓝色脊上的亮面，使沟缝更暗。笔痕虽杂乱，两只眼与横扫的笑口仍组成清楚表情结构。构图玩趣而强烈，宽大的动作笔、饱和互补色与颜料本身的厚度共同承载能量。
style_prompt_en: Heavy impasto oil paint builds a shallow sculptural field from torn, ridged strokes and palette-knife-like strips. Saturated yellow, orange, vermilion, hot pink, cobalt, turquoise, green, and black collide in broad overlapping patches, with small white openings remaining at the margins. Raised pigment catches top light along its high edges, while narrow crevices become physical dark lines. Curving red-orange bands give the composition a loose horizontal sweep; strong blue diagonals cut across it. Color is scraped and dragged rather than smoothly blended, so each layer retains a distinct material edge. The crop is extremely close and crowded, balancing a rough expressive structure with the tactile height of the paint.
style_prompt_zh: 厚重油彩以撕裂、起脊的笔触和刮刀般色条搭成浅浅的雕塑性表面。饱和黄、橙、朱红、热粉、钴蓝、青绿、绿与黑在宽阔互盖的色片中碰撞，边缘仍留少量白色开口。凸起颜料的高边接住顶光，窄沟缝变成真实暗线。弯曲红橙带给构图一道松散横扫，强蓝斜线从中切过。颜色被刮擦和拖曳，而非平滑混合，因此每一层保留清楚的物质边缘。裁幅极近且拥挤，让粗犷的表现结构与颜料可触的厚度相平衡。
theme_en: A grinning abstract face built from thick multicolored paint
theme_zh: 一张咧嘴的抽象面孔由厚厚的多色颜料堆成
name: Karel Appel
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
